description: This file defines the TalkModeController class, which manages the state and interactions related to 'talk mode' in the application. It provides methods to enable/disable talk mode, update its phase and level, pause/resume, and handle stopping speech and exiting talk mode. It integrates with various other components such as TalkOverlayController, TalkModeRuntime, GatewayConnection, and AppStateStore.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: A final class that manages the talk mode state, interactions, and updates for the application, implemented as a singleton.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, updating overlay visibility, runtime state, and resume voice wake listener if needed.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of talk mode and communicates the change to the gateway connection.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the talk mode level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes talk mode, updating state and notifying the gateway and runtime.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops the ongoing speech in talk mode, with an optional reason.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Exits talk mode by disabling talk enabled state.
